method.speeds: Raw local quaternion rad/s, simulated world endpoint m/s, world segment-direction rad/s; no peaks filtered.
method.divergence: All 35 one-second RMS bins, 30 s drive slope, first/last 5 s RMS, longest rising run, and final 1 s RMS reported per joint. No new numerical acceptance threshold.
method.residual: Exact pairwise endpoint diameter and segment-direction angular diameter for all 600 settle samples and last 120 samples.
method.spectrum: Stable anchor subtraction, mean removal, Hann window, non-DC DFT summed xyz power; power RMS normalized by N times sum(window squared). Full 5 s resolution 0.2 Hz, final 1 s resolution 1 Hz. Null only if exactly constant. A dominant bin of a decaying transient is not evidence of sustained vibration. >15 Hz is diagnostic reporting only, not a new acceptance threshold.
method.split: Single-frame local-rotation discontinuities retained separately for P3-01 L4 per direct user instruction and PR #67; not converted into a P2-05 failure criterion.
